title: Crosshair Magic - in game overlay
description:
Join the discord server here: 

Use a custom crosshair overlay in any game! Gain a competitive advantage in your favorite games.Features• Powered by GameBar for fullscreen compatibility in any game

• Upload custom images, design your own, or choose from our library of crosshairs

• Supports windowed and fullscreen mode

• Keybinds to enable/disable

• Position anywhere on the screen

• Share your designs with the community via the Steam workshop
Pixel editorWorkshop IntegrationYou can browser other users' crosshair designs on the Steam workshop. If you have made a crosshair design you're proud of, you can upload it to the workshop and share it with the community.CustomizationYou can also create your own designs by modifying parameters on a preset crosshair design. For each you can modify:
• Color

• Shape

• Thickness

• Center dot

• Location

• Size
description_short: Use a custom crosshair overlay in any game and gain a competitive advantage. Pick from a huge catalog of pre-made crosshairs or create your own.
